Select exact IC50 activity rows for human Aromatase (CHEMBL1978) that have both a canonical SMILES and a PubMed ID or DOI. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Require exact IC50 measurements (standard_type = 'IC50') and exclude rows missing canonical_smiles or both pubmed_id and doi. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, compound_records, docs, and compound_structures (INNER JOIN). Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
